The Petitioner has served the petition on the Respondents and notice of this petition has been published in the newspapers in accordance with Section 64 of the Electricity Act 2003. A general Notice dated 12.3.2020 directing the beneficiaries/ Respondents to file reply in the matter was also published on Commission’s website. No suggestions and objections have been received from the public in response to the aforesaid notices published in the newspapers by the Petitioner. None of the Respondents have filed reply in the matter. 6. The hearing in this matter was held on 24.6.2020 through video conference and the order was reserved. 7.
